content: Saulo Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-baregindii gusad

Judíoʼmar Esteban-iblosmargu, Saulo yeer-itogwichi gusmogad. Deunni, Jerusalén-neggweburgi Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad nue-ise-wilegar baregillearmalad. Degisoggu, bela amala Judea-yalaganba, degi, Samaria-neggweburse duurmakde gusmalad. Unnila Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummaganbi Jerusalénʼgi besa gusmalad.
Dulemar-Bab-Jesúsʼba-nue-nanaimaladi nuedgi Esteban-mui dikapmalad. Amar Estebanʼba nue-bukib-binsadii gusmalad.
Deun, Sauloʼdi Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad-danar-ambikunonidamalad-baregindii gualid, negayaa-negayaase machergan-baregindii, omegan-baregindii gualid. Geb agine esgaryaba metedaed.
Felipe, Samariaʼgi Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmaksad
Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad Jerusalénʼgi-ainidmaladi bela aisakidmargu, Bab-Jesúsʼgi-abonoleged-igargi bela dulemarga sunmaknadap gusmalad.
Dule-wargwen, Felipeʼye-nugadi, Samaria-neggweburse nadegusad, agi Cristoʼgine dulemarga sunmakdapid.
Dulemar, Felipe-sunmaked itoarmargu, degine, ibmar-wilubgan-dakledisulid-imaked dakarmarbargu, dulemar ese ambikunonidamalad.
Deginbali, bukidar niaburba-nikamaladi, binnasur-gote, niaburbamar egi ainiddamalad. Degi, bukidar dule-abagan-burgwar-nikamaladi, dule-muya-muya-nanamaladi, Felipe onudakmai gusad.
Degisoggu, Samaria-neggweburgi nue-weligwar-itobukwa gusmalad.

A-ibagi Samaria-neggweburgine dule-wargwen, Simónʼye-nugadi, gudigusmogad. A-dulede, ibmar-burba-wisid-duledid. Iduar dulemar-yardakdii gusad, ar ade, bukidar ibmar-dakledisurmalad-imakdii gusad. Dule-dummadye na san-sadii gusad.
Bela dulemar-burwigana, degi, serganse-bakar, nue boo itobukwadamalad, degi, bukidar sogdamalad: “We-dule, Bab-Dummad-gangued-nue-nikad-duleye.”
Bukidar Simón-ibmar-sogedba imakdedamalad, ar ade, dikasurgus Simón dulemar-yardakar, ibmar-dakledisulid-imakdisoggu, ese binsaed galeddamarsunnad.

Ar dulemar, Felipe gayaburba-nuedgi-sunmakdiid itosmargua, degi, Bab-Dummad-e-negdakmaidgi-sunmakdiid itosmargua, degine, Jesucristo-nuggi-sunmakdiid itosmargua, Samaria-dulemar e-gwagegi Jesús-abingasmalad. Geb machergan, degi, omeganse-bakale, Bab-diigi-ogleged-igar imaksamarsunnad.

Simón Bab-Jesúsʼgi bengussurmogad. Simón Bab-diigi-oglesad-sorba, Felipeʼba bipirmakdii gualid, ar ade, Simón, Felipe-ibmar-wilubgan-imaked, degi, ibmar-dakledisurmalad-dummagan-imaked geger-dakdii gualid.
Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan-Jerusalénʼgi-bukmalad wisguarmargu, Samaria-dulemar Bab-Dummad-gayaburba abingasmarye. Geb esega, Pedro, degi, Juan-ebogwa, barmismalad.
Pedro, Juan-ebogwa Samariaʼse mosmargu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-abingasmaladga Bab-Dummadse gotemalad, adi, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled abingamarmogagar.
Ar ade, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled Samaria-dorgangi amba yoo nonikid. Unnila Jesús-nugginbi diigi oglesmalad.
Degi, Pedro, Juan-ebo, Samaria-dorgangi argan mesismargu, amar Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-abinganonimarmosunnad.
Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummagan e-argan dulemargi mesisale, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled abingasdamalad. Deyob, Simón daksagu, Jesús-e-sapingan-bur-dummaganga mani ukbigualid.
Amarga sogded: —We-gangued-bemar-nikad anga udamoye, adi, doa-dulegi an-argan an mesisale, nabir Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-abingaegarmoye.
Pedro, Simón-abin sogded: —Be-manibo be soo-sailase nasun. Ar Bab-Dummad-nabir-anmargi-binsaed, anmarga ibmar-uked, manigi bakleye be bidager.
Degisoggu, bega anmarba Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled-uked-igar gwen maisulid. Ar be-gwage Bab-Dummadgi dikasur bangus naid.
Degisoggu, be-gwagegi be-sunnasur-binsasad bukib be binsasun, na be nugusun. Bab-Dummadse be gole, adi, abakalegi be-gwagegi-sunnasur-binsasad Bab-Dummad bega osuloalile.
Ar an be-dakgua, be-ulubgi ibmar-gagbidyob aimargi-nobed begi naid, degine, isguedse be bipirmasgudii an be-daked.
Simón, Pedroʼga, degi, Juanʼga sogdesun: —Anga Bab-Dummadse be gormar, adi, bela be-anga-ibmar-sogsad mer degiguegar.

Pedro, Juan-ebogwa, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nued-barsogsamalad-sorba, degi, Jesús-nuggi sunmaksamargu, gannar Jerusalénʼse armarsunnad. Jerusalénʼse danimargu, igarba Samaria-yargi neggwebur-burwigana-bukmaladga Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmakdani gusmalad.
Felipe igarba Etiopíaʼgined-ebo sunmaksad
Bab-Dummad-e-baliwitur-wargwen Felipeʼga sognonikid: “Be nae, nega-dulesulidgansik dad-nakwed-argan-nuedsik be nao. Jerusalénʼgi Gaza-neggweburse-aibillemaid-igarba be naoed.”

Degidbali, Felipe nade gussunnad. Igarba nadapgu, dule-wargwen Etiopíaʼgined dakalid, dule-alugwag-gwasualed. A-dulede, dule-dummadid, ar ade, Etiopíaʼmar-rey-bundor-Candaceʼga mani-daked-duled. A-dulede, Jerusalén-neggweburse Bab-nug odummogega arbigusad.
Etiopía-dule gannar na e-negse nadapgu, e-moli-urgi sii, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-narmaksagusad-absonadapi gusad.
Agi Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled Felipeʼga sogded: “Ese be nae, e-moli-ur-yase walikaa be nae.”
Felipe ese nadsunnad. Walikgusgu, Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged-Isaías-narmaksadi, a-absonadap itoalid. Degi, Felipe ese egisdesunnad: —Degite, be-absonadapid, ¿mag be itoge?
Dule-Etiopíaʼgined, abin-sogded: —¿Sunna mag an itogosi, ar dule anga odulosulir, we ibi-obare? Degisoggu, Felipeʼga sogdesunnad: —An-moli-urse be nakwe, an-dikarba be sigdage.
Etiopía-dule, Bab-Dummad-Garda-narmakaled-absonadapid, wegi-narmakar naido:

content.text: Bela-bela egi dodosmaladgi, igar-maidba gwen ega imaksasurmalad,

content: Isaías 53:7-8
Etiopía-dule Felipeʼse egisdesun: —Anga be soge, ¿we doagi Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsoged sunmake? ¿An na dukin soge, igi, dule-baidgi sunmake?
Degi, Felipe, Isaías-garda-narmakar-gebe-onogedgi ega sunmakded. Geb Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nued-Jesúsʼgi-soglesadgi ega sunmaksabalid.
Degi, igarba nadapmargu, dii nai dakarmalad. Agi Etiopía-dule Felipeʼga sogded: —Dii be dake. ¿Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi geg an oglege?
Felipe, abin-imakded: —Ar na be Jesucristoʼgi nue-bensulile, be sunna Jesús-nuggi diigi oglegodo. Etiopía-dule, Felipe-abin sogded: —An bensulid, Jesucristo Bab-Dummad-Machi-sunnadid.
Degi, Etiopía-dule moli-ur-nasiksasunnad. Degine, ebo diise aidesmarsunnad. Geb Felipe Etiopía-dule Bab-diigi-ogleged-igargi ogsasunnad.
Dii-yagi-gwichi nakwiarmargu, Bab-Dummad-Burba-Isligwaled ukiar Felipe-sesagusad. Etiopía-duledi bar gwen Felipe-daksasulid, degi-inigwele, bela-bela weligwar e-negse nadapgusad.
Felipeʼdi bato Azoto-neggweburgi gudii daklealid. Felipe neggwebur-ilibali, Bab-Dummad-Gayaburba-Nuedgi sunmaknadapgusad, deyob Cesarea-neggweburse warmaksad.
